BEFORE YOU GO

A few helpful answers.

How do I book a ride?

Use the trip form to send your pickup, destination, and date through WhatsApp, or call 0781 293 004 / 0748 221 629. Our team will confirm your vehicle, price, and arrangements.

How much does a journey cost?

Request a personalised quote for your route, date, vehicle, and group size. Confirm all inclusions with our team before booking.

Can you take us beyond Kampala?

Yes. Elite Transporters serves districts throughout Uganda and major border points. Contact us to confirm your route and any border arrangements.

Can I arrange transport for a group or company?

Yes. Tell us your passenger count, luggage needs, and itinerary. We arrange group, hotel, corporate, NGO, and special-event transport subject to vehicle availability.
